goal_details.name: summarize
goal_details.response: Per article HR-TK-ART-03, employees can obtain an employment certificate through ESS > My Documents > Certificates > Employment Certificate, with a processing time of 3 working days.

story: You are Emilia Saarinen, new HR Coordinator at the Finland desk. You ask how to get an employment certificate for an employee who needs it for a bank.
